items.title: US launches more strikes on Iran with blasts reported in south of country
items.description: Trump says the attacks are "retribution for yesterday's bombing of ships by Iran". Iran earlier promised strong retaliation.

items.title: US strikes target Iranian military boats
items.description: The US has launched the strikes on Iran in response to attacks on three oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz.

items.title: Ukraine to get licence to produce Patriot missiles, Trump says
items.description: Although the Patriots are highly effective against Russia's ballistic missiles, they also have lengthy production times.

items.title: German doctor jailed for murder of 15 patients and suspected of more
items.description: The German palliative care doctor has been sentenced to life imprisonment for killing 15 of his patients.

items.title: Teenager arrested after two girls, 13, seriously injured in German school attack
items.description: Police said a major operation was under way in the area of Welfen-Gymnasium secondary school in Schongau, Bavaria.

items.title: Arizona toddler found alive in hospital morgue after declared dead from drowning
items.description: After he was discovered to still be alive, the 18-month-old was flown to another hospital and survived.

items.title: Nato allies announce £37bn for new missile project
items.description: Prime Minister Sir Keir Starmer will convene around a dozen leaders to discuss the programme in Ankara.

items.title: Eight killed after landslide hits girls' school in Bangladesh
items.description: Rescuers pull bodies from the mud after heavy monsoon rains batter the south-eastern coast.

items.title: Nigeria's president demands to know how fake agency was allegedly set up in his office
items.description: Adeniyi Adeyemi allegedly forged a letter of appointment and secured funding for an agency the presidency knew nothing about.

items.title: Trains and emergency calls affected after major outage at Australia's largest telecoms company
items.description: Servers at data centres in Sydney and Melbourne were to blame but the exact cause remains unknown.

items.title: Khamenei's coffin carried through Shia shrines as ceremonies held in Iraq
items.description: The remains of Iran's late supreme leader are transported to Najaf and Karbala, as funeral ceremonies continue for a fifth day.

items.title: Cubans protest after third nationwide power cut this year
items.description: While Cuban officials said that power had been mostly restored, those still left in the dark vented their anger.
